notes.title: WORKSHOP NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]http://www.kbrosinc.com/steam/DonaldDumpHeader.png[/img]

We are very excited to announce that the workshop is now available and players can create, share and download new characters! 

To kick it off we have provided you with a new character to try out.

Simply go to the workshop, subscribe to him and go to your character selection menu in-game. 

We can’t wait to see what the community comes up with.

Our plan is to continue rolling out new functions to the workshop such as a complete level editor and custom to-poo list maker so that you can make and share your own levels.

This update also includes a couple of bug fixes and features namely: 

[b]---BUG FIXES---[/b]
[list]
    [*]Poop falling short of aimer in some instances.
    [*]Game not loading previous save on startup.
    [*]Various glitches with scoreboard and menu.
    [*]Round ending while character still has power ups left to use.
[/list]


[b]---FEATURES---[/b]

[list]
    [*]An option to reset the game and clear the to-poo list for those who want to start poopin afresh or have their friends poop. *note this will not reset your achievements
[/list]


HAPPY POOPING!
